GROUND-TRUTH 2026-09-07: engine-core's tsconfig.json excludes src/**/__tests__/** from typecheck, and vitest does not typecheck at all (only transpiles) — a @ts-expect-error fixture placed in a __tests__ file proves NOTHING is actually checked; it must live in a plain src/ file (unimported, but still inside tsconfig's include glob) for `tsc --noEmit` to ever see it. Relevant any time a future card asks to 'verify by compiler refusal' in this repo.

LESSON: a hand-picked read-only storage wrapper for a live-verify script (forwarding only the methods you think you'll need) is a live footgun — composeSitePlanModelForParcel's actual call graph reaches listRoadAtomsByRoadNodeId via resolve-attaching-roads.ts, easy to miss by inspection. A Proxy that forwards every method except the one being intercepted is the safe pattern for any future read-only-verify script against a real StoragePort.
